name: gelu_and_mul
description: Fused gated exact GELU. Splits hidden_states of shape [...,2*d] into x1=...[:d] and x3=...[d:], computes gelu_exact(x1.float())*x3.float() in float32, and casts to the input dtype. The Triton candidate currently assumes a 2-D contiguous input; the reference supports leading dimensions. Returns a new tensor shaped [...,d]. Current tests exercise bfloat16 2-D inputs with d 16..8192; no mutation.
